name: pgs
description: Non-interactive git staging at file, hunk, and line granularity. MCP server and skill for structured commit workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Stage and commit precise git changes through MCP
interface.longDescription: Use pgs to inspect unstaged and staged changes, stage or unstage files, hunks, and line ranges, validate commit plans, and create commits through a local stdio MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Split my git changes into atomic commits with pgs.
Stage selected hunks and create a commit.
